content: {"praised":["Beautiful depiction of small farm challenges over a full year.","Balances idealism with harsh reality of labor and weather.","Humorous, plucky characters bring light to rural struggles.","Engaging slice‑of‑life narrative about novice farmers.","Realistic portrayal that opens viewers' eyes to farming."],"criticized":["Lacks research and planning behind farming efforts.","Contains expletives that may offend family viewers.","Omits financial details and long‑term viability.","Leaves many questions unanswered.","No mention of cost or sustainability metrics."]}
